overview_description.description:
Postman is a complete API development environment, used by nearly six million developers and more than 200,000 companies worldwide. It offers a platform for developers or enterprises to build, test, and debug their APIs. The platform intends to use the funds to continue to expand operations and its business reach.

Postman is an elegant, flexible tool used to build connected software via APIs quickly, easily, and accurately. It enables API-first development, automated testing, and developer onboarding. The platform's features simplify each step of building an API and streamline collaboration so they can create better APIs faster.

about_short_description.short_description: Postman is a software company that offers a platform for the users to design, develop, test, and organize custom APIs.

product.name: Postman API Platform
product.description: An API development platform for designing, building, testing, managing, and distributing APIs and services across teams and organizations.

product.name: Postman API Client
product.description: A tool for sending API requests, inspecting responses, and developing and debugging API integrations.

product.name: Postman Workspaces
product.description: Collaborative environments for organizing API work, sharing collections and specifications, and coordinating development across teams.

product.name: Postman Collections
product.description: Reusable groups of API requests and related scripts used to organize, document, test, and automate API workflows.

product.name: Postman Collection Runner
product.description: A tool for executing collections of API requests in sequence to automate workflows and run repeatable tests.

product.name: Postman Spec Hub
product.description: A workspace for managing API specifications and supporting specification-driven API design and development.
